checkpoint: 7F (PokemonTower_7F map.json, scripts.inc): column 11 is the only way up to Mr. Fuji (11, 4), and three Grunts look across it, 4 tiles each: (9, 10) east, (13, 8) west, (9, 6) east. Each is fought on the first tile of column 11 in his line; each walks off after his battle and is removed (FLAG_HIDE_TOWER_ROCKET_1..3). Mr. Fuji's talk warps the player to his house (warp MAP_LAVENDER_TOWN_VOLUNTEER_POKEMON_HOUSE, 4, 7); talked to again there, he gives the POKE FLUTE (pokeguy 1:11:04 to 1:11:24). The save is in his house: LAVENDER TOWN on the save card.
The facing after the script's warp is not measured; north is assumed (the player faced north to talk).
